args.command:
python - <<'PY'
import sys
from reflex.utils.format import length_of_largest_common_substring

cases = [
    ("abcXz", "abcYz"),
    ("zzhelloQx", "aahelloRx"),
    ("mountain-path", "plain-mountain-x"),
    ("ab12c", "ab34c"),
    ("red-blue-green", "xx-blue-yy-green"),
    ("compile-cache-z", "recompile-store-z"),
    ("id-12345-x", "zz-12345-y-x"),
    ("alpha_beta_q", "alpha_gamma_q"),
    ("startMIDend", "xxMIDyyend"),
    ("aa-render-b", "zz-render-c-b"),
]

TARGET_FILE = "reflex/utils/format.py"
TARGET_LINE = 54

records = []

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    if event == "line":
        filename = frame.f_code.co_filename.replace('\\\\', '/')
        if filename.endswith(TARGET_FILE) and frame.f_lineno == TARGET_LINE:
            loc = frame.f_locals
            dp = loc["dp"]
            i = loc["i"]
            j = loc["j"]
            max_length = loc["max_length"]
            val = dp[i][j]
            records.append((val, max_length, val >= max_length, i, j))
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)
for a,b in cases:
    length_of_largest_common_substring(a,b)
sys.settrace(None)

print(f"total_evals={len(records)}")
print(f"all_hold={all(r[2] for r in records)}")
violations = [r for r in records if not r[2]]
print(f"violations={len(violations)}")
if violations:
    print("first_violation", violations[0])
PY
